title: Single hieratic sign, Kairo, Institut français d’archéologie orientale, 714 (AKU HT 64634)

source.attribution: Facsimile by Maren Goecke-Bauer; AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 64634

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 64634; AKU grapheme N0340 (AKU GR 412). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: N29 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 319. Occurrence: line 4; find place Deir el-Medina; writing direction "Kolumnen, linksläufig prograd"; ink colour "schwarz"; sign size 7.5 x 7.6 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Neues Reich, 20. Dynastie". Facsimile type: Digitalisat (Kooperationspartner), by Maren Goecke-Bauer. Rendered from the source SVG facsimile to PNG at 20 px/mm (long edge clamped to 160-600 px) on a white background with a white margin.
